name: Nscale
summary: UK-based AI data-centre developer, tracked for its proposed Loughton, Essex site, which has drawn objections from the town council over cooling and energy demand. No community-impact page was found in the research.

name: Segro
summary: Commercial property firm tracked for its 75 MW Le Bourget, France project at a former warehouse, which faces a newly elected mayor's demand for cancellation. It is a property developer rather than a hyperscale operator, and no community-impact page was found in the research.

name: Goodman Group
summary: Australian property group tracked for its withdrawn 90 MW Project Mars application in Lane Cove, NSW. No community-impact page was found in the research.

name: Sur Energy
hq: Argentina / United States (described as Argentine-U.S. owned)
summary: Energy and data-centre company tracked because its co-founder, Emiliano Kargieman, made a named first-party statement about jobs and investment for the announced OpenAI-linked AI data-centre project in Argentina. The project's site and binding contract were not confirmed in the research, so no project record is included.
